As an Data Consultant-Data Governance, you will act as a trusted advisor to Client IT, providing expertise in infrastructure, security, and risk management. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure high-quality technical support, meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and adhering to process compliance. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Analyze and Resolve Incidents: Analyze and resolve infrastructure-related incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring prompt restoration of services. In line with applicable pay transparency requirements, we are sharing the annual base pay range (gross). 27.000EUR – 57.200 EUR.
